notes: Derived edit. Animal classes are individuals (instance_of), so the class can be a value of transmitted_by_class. The definitional premise "a disease is transmitted by an animal of whatever class its carrier belongs to" is the role chain transmitted_by ∘ instance_of ⊑ transmitted_by_class (OWL, so it also reaches an unnamed carrier). The direct question ("an insect or an arachnid?") presupposes that the two classes exclude each other, for a disease and for an animal: two firm disjointness axioms. q1 reads "of the same class as X" over the two classes in play.

queries.ask: plague : transmitted_by_class some ({insect, arachnid} and inv(instance_of) value spiders)
